KJDRAW / API REFERENCE

API reference

Choose the task-oriented Editor API or search the complete declaration-driven TypeScript reference.

Choose the right API layer

KJDraw publishes two reference layers:

  • The Editor API is the recommended application entry. It documents every createKJDrawEditor() option, property, method and event with JavaScript, React and Vue examples.
  • The complete TypeScript reference is generated from every public package export and type declaration. Use its search when building custom tools, headless workflows, plugins or file adapters.

Both references are generated during the documentation build. CI rejects stale Editor API names, missing package exports, broken deep links and search-index drift.

Find an API by task

TaskStart here
Mount a ready editorcreateKJDrawEditor() in the Editor API
Open KJD or DXFKJDrawEditor.open()
Save KJD or DXFKJDrawEditor.save()
Execute, undo or redo an editKJDrawEditor.execute(), undo(), redo()
Control selection and viewgetSelection(), setSelection(), fit(), setTool()
Build without the ready editorKJDrawSDK, KJDocument, commands and transactions in the complete reference
Read or propose agent changesKJAgentToolSession in @kanjieteam/kjdraw/agent-tools and runKJAgentTask in /agent-runner
Import or export formatsFile-adapter exports and the Files and projects guide
Compile domain knowledgeKnowledge-pack and compiler types plus the Knowledge packs guide

Package entry points

Use the root package for the ready editor and common SDK surface. Import narrower entry points only when the integration needs them:

import { createKJDrawEditor } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw'
import { KJDraw } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/react'
import { KJAgentToolSession } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/agent-tools'
import { createDXFFileAdapter } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/file/dxf'

The package exports map is authoritative. The complete reference lists only public symbols reachable through those entry points.

KJDRAW / API 参考

API 参考

按任务使用编辑器 API，或搜索由类型声明生成的完整 TypeScript 参考。

选择正确的 API 层

KJDraw 发布两层参考：

  • 编辑器 API是推荐的应用入口，包含 createKJDrawEditor() 的全部选项、属性、方法、事件，以及 JavaScript、React、Vue 示例。
  • 完整 TypeScript 参考由全部公开包导出与类型声明生成。构建自定义工具、无界面流程、插件或文件适配器时，可在这里搜索。

两层参考都会在文档构建期间生成。CI 会拒绝过期的编辑器 API 名称、缺失的包导出、失效深链接和搜索索引漂移。

按任务查找 API

任务从这里开始
挂载完整编辑器编辑器 API 中的 createKJDrawEditor()
打开 KJD 或 DXFKJDrawEditor.open()
保存 KJD 或 DXFKJDrawEditor.save()
执行、撤销或重做修改KJDrawEditor.execute()、undo()、redo()
控制选择与视图getSelection()、setSelection()、fit()、setTool()
不使用完整编辑器进行构建完整参考中的 KJDrawSDK、KJDocument、命令与事务
读取或提出 Agent 修改@kanjieteam/kjdraw/agent-tools 的 KJAgentToolSession；模型循环见 /agent-runner 的 runKJAgentTask
导入或导出格式文件适配器导出与文件和工程指南

包入口

完整编辑器与常用 SDK 能力使用根包；只有接入确实需要时再导入更窄的入口：

import { createKJDrawEditor } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw'
import { KJDraw } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/react'
import { KJAgentToolSession } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/agent-tools'
import { createDXFFileAdapter } from '@kanjieteam/kjdraw/file/dxf'

包的 exports 映射是权威边界；完整参考只列出可以通过这些入口访问的公开符号。
